summary.name: TotalFinder
summary.one_liner: TotalFinder is a Mac add-on that adds Chrome-style tabs, dual-pane Finder windows, colored labels and other enhancements to Apple's Finder.
use_cases: add tabs to the Mac Finder
view two Finder windows side by side
move files with keyboard cut and paste
open Finder quickly with a hotkey
summary.what_it_does: TotalFinder extends the macOS Finder with Chrome-style tabs. It can display two Finder windows side-by-side in a dual mode toggled by a hot-key. Its visor window keeps Finder one key-press away. It restores full colors to Finder labels in El Capitan and newer. It also adds keyboard-shortcut cut and paste for moving files.
notable: Chrome-style tabs for Finder, which the page says were added in Snow Leopard
Dual mode for side-by-side Finder windows via hot-key
Visor window for instant Finder access
Cut and paste of files with keyboard shortcuts
caveats: Page does not state pricing or licensing terms
Colored labels feature is described for El Capitan and newer macOS versions
